title: Cookie Monster Has ‘Got to Go!’ (Potty) in Parody Video of Chappell Roan’s Hit for ‘Sesame Street’
summary: The song is now a potty-training anthem and includes a very catchy spelling lesson for the visual.
contentText:
If you thought “Hot to Go!” by Chappell Roan couldn’t get any catchier, Sesame Street has entered the chat.

Related

Bye-Bye, ‘Baby Shark’: Spotify Lets Parents Keep Kids’ Music From Taking Over Year-End ‘Wrapped’ Recap

And because this is Sesame Street , there’s a little learning tucked into the choreography, too.

As the characters sing along, colorful letters pop up to spell out “P-O-T-T-Y” — giving young viewers a musical reminder of what to do when their bodies tell them it’s time to go. The familiar, instantly recognizable structure of Roan’s song makes the lesson feel more like a dance party instead of a simple potty-training tutorial.

The video is the a sparkly addition to Sesame Street ‘s Parody Party , a seven-song collection of kid-friendly takes on some of pop’s biggest recent hits. The album, released July 26 through Arts Music, also features Sesame Street spins on Bruno Mars ‘ “I Just Might,” RAYE ‘s “Where Is My Husband!,” HUNTR/X ‘s “Golden” from KPop Demon Hunters , Taylor Swift ‘s “Shake It Off,” Icona Pop ‘s “I Love It” and Carly Rae Jepsen ‘s “Call Me Maybe.”
